# Tablassert
> Extract knowledge assertions from tabular data into NCATS Translator-compliant KGX NDJSON using declarative YAML, embedded redb-backed entity resolution, and staged quality control.

This file is for two audiences: (1) YAML configuration authors and (2) package contributors.
When source code and prose docs disagree, treat `src/tablassert/models.py` and `src/tablassert/cli.py` as the current authority.
If you encounter older configurations, migrate `datassert:` to `fullmap:` (the graph-config field pointing at the entity-resolution database).
Current CLI behavior queries an embedded redb database whose primary file is `fullmap/data/fullmap.redb`; its sibling RECORDS shard files (`fullmap.s*.redb`, in the same directory) are required for lookup and must stay co-located with it.

## Quickstart
- [README](README.md): high-level overview, install snippets, and one-command graph build.
- [Installation Guide](docs/installation.md): local/dev/tool installation paths. Optional extras: `rt` (runtime-compatible Polars), `aria2` (bundled aria2c downloader), `qc` (quality-control runtime), `agent` (autonomous agent), and `optimize` (GEPA prompt optimization).
- [CLI Reference](docs/cli.md): command syntax for building graphs and validating table configs.
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): first end-to-end run from CSV input to KGX NDJSON output.

## YAML Authoring
- [Table Configuration Reference](docs/configuration/table.md): the table (`Section`) schema, template/sections patterns, and field semantics.
- [Graph Configuration Reference](docs/configuration/graph.md): the `Graph` config fields (`name`/`version`/`description`/`tables`/`fullmap`) and orchestration model.
- [Use Case Gallery](docs/examples.md): real-world table-configuration patterns for common data types.
- [Tutorial Table Example](docs/examples/tutorial-table.yaml): minimal working TC4 table configuration.
- [Tutorial Graph Example](docs/examples/tutorial-graph.yaml): minimal GC3 graph configuration.
- [Advanced Example](docs/configuration/advanced-example.md): complex regex, filtering, annotations, and section overrides.

## CLI and Runtime
- [CLI Entry Point](src/tablassert/cli.py): command implementations and build pipeline stages.
- [Pydantic Models](src/tablassert/models.py): authoritative schema for `Section` and `Graph`.
- [YAML Ingestion](src/tablassert/ingests.py): `from_yaml()`, `to_sections()`, and template/section merge behavior.
- [Fullmap Guide](docs/fullmap.md): entity-resolution database build pipeline and redb schema.

## Contributor Development
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, style conventions, checks, and PR expectations.
- [Development](docs/development.md): docs-site contributor setup and the local `uv run mkdocs build --strict` docs gate.
- [Project Metadata](pyproject.toml): dependencies, tooling config, and CLI entrypoint. Optional extras: `rt`, `aria2`, `qc`, `agent`, and `optimize`.
- [Tests](tests/): pytest coverage and fixtures.
- [MkDocs Configuration](mkdocs.yml): docs navigation and published pages.
- [GitHub Workflows](.github/workflows/): release, docs, docker, and autotag automation.

## Implementation Map
- [Core Pipeline](src/tablassert/lib.py): extraction transforms, statement assembly, and graph compilation.
- [Entity Resolution](src/tablassert/fullmap.py): embedded redb synonym resolution and ranking logic.
- [Quality Control](src/tablassert/qc.py): exact, fuzzy, and BioBERT validation stages.
- [Graph Study](src/tablassert/study.py): stdlib-only assertions over the final KGX NDJSON, run as the `build-kg --qc` stage 7.
- [Normalization](src/tablassert/nlp.py): text normalization levels and preprocessing helpers.
- [Enums Catalog](src/tablassert/enums.py): allowed values for predicates, qualifiers, categories, repositories, knowledge levels, agent types, and transforms.
- [Utilities](src/tablassert/utils.py): hashing, storage path constants, and filesystem helpers.
- [Optional Extras Registry](src/tablassert/extras.py): the package → extra mapping behind the missing-dependency errors and their install hints.
